snippet.title: Fleshgrinder Trailer
snippet.description:
Play the demo and wishlist right now at
https://store.steampowered.com/app/5074630/Fleshgrinder/

Fleshgrinder is an isometric, post-apocalyptic Action-RPG, which tries to present a possible distopian future where most 
of the population has been infected with a digital virus, made possible by having invasive augmentations
in our bodies, connected to our nervous systes. Implants like Neuralink are bound to be commonplace in the near future to
upskill our species and enable us to have faster and better control over computer systems.

What happens when the information stops being one-way through these systems?
Will they be able to manipulate us on such a level that an intelligent,
digital virus could take over the minds of the augmented population?

Players of Fleshgrinder take on a desperate mission to lead a squad of maximum three operatives
to try and stop this intelligent virus controlling us as a hive-mind, causing an extinction level incident in the near future.

Interact with factions and their NPC-s in a huge persistent world, solving puzzles and side-quests with optional friendly fire,
hardcore permadeath mode, dismemberment physics, randomized mission areas, 30+ unique weapons, 60+ armors, augmentations, consumables,
ammo types with deep penetration mechanics and tons of loot with highly randomized attributes.

FLESHGRINDER: Evolution Without Waiting. Extinction Without Mercy.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/5074630/Fleshgrinder/

https://www.fleshgrinder.com

https://fleshgrinder.itch.io/
